 Oral Order
2 12-03-2024
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned App for the State.
2.  The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Nautan P.S. Case No. 444 of 2023 registered for the offence under Sections 341, 323, 325, 326, 307, 504, 506, 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, the petitioner and others are said to have killed the deceased.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in this case.
He further submits that the petitioner is the cousin father-in-law and there is general and omnibus allegation against all the accused persons.

Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.15001 of 2024(2)
dt.12-03-2024 6.
Considering the general and omnibus allegations against all the accused persons, this application is allowed.
